##### Project general facts

Canal Crown by DAMAC Properties, created in collaboration with the luxury jewellery house de GRISOGONO, is a striking residential tower on the bank of the canal. Inspired by the brilliance and mystique of the rare peridot gemstone, the tower introduces a bold architectural concept that combines distinctive design with refined luxury living. The collection offers studios and one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom residences surrounded by panoramic views of the canal and the skyline.

Residents enjoy a curated selection of premium amenities that reflect the celestial and wellness-inspired concept of the tower. Infinity-style pools, wellness zones and relaxation lounges sit alongside luxurious leisure spaces and lifestyle facilities, creating an immersive residential experience. The waterfront setting and close proximity to the city centre combine exceptional connectivity with a vibrant, cosmopolitan atmosphere for residents and their guests.

Interiors combine high-quality materials with sophisticated contemporary finishes that emphasise elegance and comfort. Spacious layouts are complemented by expansive windows that maximise natural light and frame views of the city. Kitchens are fitted with premium Siemens appliances, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalise each space according to their own style and vision.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is a dynamic central district along the Dubai Water Canal, combining office towers, hotels, residential buildings and waterfront promenades. Fine dining, boutique cafes, gyms, art spaces and supermarkets line the canal and the surrounding streets, creating a vibrant urban atmosphere within walking distance of Downtown Dubai and its landmark attractions.

Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Financial Centre Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Business Bay metro station is close by. The Dubai Water Canal promenade is a short walk away, Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall are close by, and the Dubai International Financial Centre, City Walk and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Business Bay is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most liquid residential markets in Dubai. Proximity to Downtown Dubai and the main business districts attracts professionals, entrepreneurs and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy and strong rental demand. Branded canal-side residences with distinctive concepts underpin premium rental rates and long-term value for investors.
